anomalies.observed: Both GND1 (logic-side) and GND2 (bus-side) pins of the isolated CAN transceivers U22 and U38 are tied to the same GND net.
anomalies.expected: For isolated CAN, GND1 and GND2 should be on separate ground nets (e.g., logic GND and isolated CAN GND); the specification calls for isolated CAN transceivers.

evidence.quote: two isolated CAN buses (CAN0, CAN1), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller ... through an isolated CAN transceiver

anomalies.impact: Galvanic isolation is bypassed; the CAN buses share the motherboard ground, defeating the intended isolation and risking ground loops, common-mode noise, or damage.

anomalies.observed: R47 value field is '24k', but its description says 24Ω and its MPN is FRC0805J240TSD, which decodes as a 24Ω 5% resistor.
anomalies.expected: Value, MPN and description should agree; a bleeder across VOUTP/VOUTN should be high resistance (24k as in the value field), not 24Ω.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R47") (value "24k") ... (description " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS") ... (field (name "MPN") "FRC0805J240TSD"))

anomalies.impact: If assembled per the MPN/description, a 24Ω resistor is placed across VOUTP/VOUTN, causing excessive current/power dissipation and likely damage; if the value field is used, the BOM is inconsistent.

anomalies.observed: D37 pin4 (A2) is on /NET0143, and its cathode pin2 (K2) returns through R56 to the same /NET0143 net instead of ground.
anomalies.expected: The LED cathode resistor should return to GND (or another proper return) so the LED can conduct when /NET0143 is driven; both ends of the LED/resistor branch should not land on the same signal net.
anomalies.impact: The second element of dual LED D37 has no current return path and will not illuminate, so the intended status indication is missing.

parsed.summary: The design files contain several real deviations: the isolated CAN transceivers have their logic and bus grounds tied together, defeating isolation; R47 has a 24k vs 24Ω value/MPN conflict; and the second D37 LED cathode resistor is connected back to its anode net rather than to ground, so that LED cannot light.
